international_instruments.limitation: Universal declaration is not itself a treaty; possible customary law implications require separate analysis
Verify state-party status, reservations, domestic effect and applicable rights
Verify ratification, progressive realization, domestic effect
US not state party; national child duties depend on jurisdiction and service
Party-specific status; private actor not UNESCO-recognized by citation
Copyright not new sovereign rights, domain or ownership proof
Armed conflict thresholds; emblem use restricted; no routine digital jurisdiction
2024 amendments effective 2025-09-19 for relevant parties subject to rejections/reservations; do not assume all parties have same text
Only ratifying states are treaty parties; consultation not ownership of peoples' culture
State obligations and asylum procedures; do not claim private grant of status
Artificial islands no own territorial sea, historical 1968 Rose Island predates 1982 treaty; do not retroactively apply
Criteria and recognition distinct; not substitute proof of statehood

special_case.legal_limit: Neither a domain nor a data center nor artificial platform independently creates territory or statehood; UNCLOS 1982 postdates the 1968 episode; historical interpretation requires careful temporal analysis.
